Circuit schedule

What I do

Every job quoted upfront, done properly, and tested before I leave. Pick a circuit.

CircuitServiceWhat it covers
C01 Split system air conditioning Reverse-cycle split systems, supplied and installed — cooling for summer, cheap heating for winter. C02 Ducted air conditioning Whole-house ducted reverse-cycle, including swapping out old ducted gas heating. C03 Air-con servicing & repairs Cleans, re-gassing and repairs — before the first heatwave, not during it. C04 Switchboard & power upgrades Old fuses out, circuit breakers and safety switches in — with room for air-con and more. C05 Rental electrical safety checks The two-yearly check every Victorian rental needs from 13 October 2026. Written report included. C06 Breakdowns & emergencies Air-con dead in a heatwave, or power out? [24/7] call-outs. C07 EV charger installation Home chargers installed and load-checked against your air-con and switchboard. C08 Power points & lighting Extra power points, USB outlets, LED downlights and outdoor lighting. C09 Ceiling & exhaust fans Ceiling fans, bathroom and kitchen exhaust fans. C10 Fault finding & smoke alarms Tripping power, dead circuits, and hardwired smoke alarms. C11 Commercial air-con & electrical Shops, offices and small commercial — installs, servicing and maintenance.
